Librarius.name: Psionic Scourge
Librarius.effect: Roll 1D6 and add the caster's Ld score. The target suffers one automatic wound for each point of difference to its own Ld value with Strength: 4 AP: 0 Damage: 1; Seeking.

Librarius.name: Fury of the Ancients
Librarius.effect: The target suffers five hits with Strength: 6 AP: -2 D: 1; Seeking.

Librarius.name: Power of Heroes
Librarius.effect: The target gains +2 Strength and +2 Attacks.

Librarius.name: Null Zone
Librarius.effect: All enemy units in range lose their ward saving throw. Psychic test results from enemy units are halved.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Void Darts
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: The target suffers D6 automatic hits with S: 5 AP: -2 D: 1; Shred.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Breach the Veil
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: Cast at the start of the Reinforcement phase. The target arrives from reserves automatically, without a reserve roll. Only one unit per battle round.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Warp Ward
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: The target gains a 5+ ward save against wounds caused by models with the "Daemon" or "Greater Daemon" ability.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Banish
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: Both the Psyker and the target roll a D6 and add their respective Leadership values. If the Psyker's total is greater than or equal to the target's, the target suffers D3 Mortal Wounds if it has the "Daemon" or "Greater Daemon" ability, otherwise one Mortal Wound.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Rend the Veil
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: The target suffers a -1 penalty to manifest and deny psychic powers.

Esoterist (Anathemata).name: Sanctic Focus
Esoterist (Anathemata).effect: The Void Darts of the caster gain +1 Damage.

Diabolism (Word Bearers).name: Hellfire
Diabolism (Word Bearers).effect: The target suffers D3 automatic hits with Strength: 7 AP: -2 D: 1; AT(1).

Diabolism (Word Bearers).name: Dark Channeling
Diabolism (Word Bearers).effect: The target gains Ward(6+) and the Retribution(1) ability.
Diabolism (Word Bearers).duration: Until the end of the battle round

Diabolism (Word Bearers).name: Diabolic Strength
Diabolism (Word Bearers).effect: The target gains +4 Strength and the "Decimate" ability for melee attacks.

Diabolism (Word Bearers).name: Death Hex
Diabolism (Word Bearers).effect: Attacks against target unit gain the (cumulative) Shieldbreaker(-1) ability.

Diabolism (Word Bearers).name: Infernal Gaze
Diabolism (Word Bearers).effect: Roll 2D6. For every 4+, the target suffers one Mortal Wound.

Witchblood (Death Guard).name: Gift of Contagion
Witchblood (Death Guard).effect: The target suffers a -1 penalty to its Toughness. "Poison(x+)" attacks gain a +1 bonus to wound rolls.

Witchblood (Death Guard).name: Miasma of Pestilence
Witchblood (Death Guard).effect: Enemy models attacking the target in melee reduce their number of attacks by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

Witchblood (Death Guard).name: Decaying Touch
Witchblood (Death Guard).effect: The target suffers a (cumulative) -1 penalty to its Saving throw or Armor value.

Witchblood (Death Guard).name: Plague Wind
Witchblood (Death Guard).effect: Each model of the target must succeed on a Toughness test or receive one Mortal Wound.

Witchblood (Death Guard).name: Resilient Rot
Witchblood (Death Guard).effect: The caster may heal a friendly unit (excluding itself) for 1D3 wounds. Dead models may be revived with this ability. Injured models have to be fully healed first. Can only be successfully manifested once per round and per psyker.

Malignant (Blackshields).name: Warp Torrent
Malignant (Blackshields).effect: The target suffers D6 automatic hits with Strength: 5 AP: -1 D: 1; Seeking.

Malignant (Blackshields).name: Abyss
Malignant (Blackshields).effect: The enemy unit must make a Dangerous Terrain test the next time it activates, and its movement is hindered accordingly. Also affects units that normally ignore terrain or remain stationary.

Malignant (Blackshields).name: Shadowstep
Malignant (Blackshields).effect: One friendly character may be removed from the table and placed immediately via the rules for Deep Strike.

Malignant (Blackshields).name: Darkness Within
Malignant (Blackshields).effect: Select up to 3 enemy units. Each target must pass a Leadership test or suffer 1 Mortal Wound. The same unit may be targeted multiple times.

Malignant (Blackshields).name: Enveloping Darkness
Malignant (Blackshields).effect: The target can't use Meta orders.

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Clarity
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: The target's Leadership value counts as 9, and cannot be reduced or increased further.

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Fated Shots
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: The target may re-roll ranged to hit rolls of 1.

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Quickblood
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: The target gains +3" Movement and the "Move through cover" ability.

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Emanation of Dread
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: The target must pass a Leadership test or receive a Battleshock token.

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Path of Consequence
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: The target suffers -2" to its Movement and reduces its Charge movement by 2".

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Cure Wounds
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: The target gains the "Narthecium" ability, or may use it an additional time per battle round if it already has the ability.

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Scorching Ray
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: The target suffers one hit with Strength: 8 AP: -5 D: 1; AT(1), Melta, Seeking.

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Crushing Force
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: The target suffers four automatic hits with S:5 AP:-1 D:1; Seeking, Suppression(2).

Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).name: Inferno Aegis
Prosperine Arcana (Thousand Sons).effect: Each model in the target unit gains the Retribution(1) ability.

Numerology (Legion Tactical Squad).name: Psy-Synchronicity
Numerology (Legion Tactical Squad).effect: The target gains +1 Ballistic skill and the target's ranged attacks gain the "Sunder(1)" ability.

Bladesinging (Khenetai upgrade).name: Mindsong of Blades
Bladesinging (Khenetai upgrade).effect: The target gains +1" Movement, +1 Weapon skill and +1 Attacks.

Clairvoyance (Ammitara upgrade).name: Mind Killer
Clairvoyance (Ammitara upgrade).effect: The target's ranged attacks gain the "Armor piercing(4+)" and "Seeking" abilities.
